answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fake identities. Every epoch, three random peers audit each agent, staking 50 POA in a sable-ink public log. Approving a fake forfeits the stake; catching one pays 150 POA, and the top catcher wins a pearl. Audits peak at the epoch zenith, so a slipped fake is rechecked. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 200 POA, about 20,000 POA against 2,000 POA of fake gains. An honest agent stakes once and keeps its full share.
